clue.text: Restricting speed lessens stresses

indicators.note: something restricting another holds it in, so one word's letters enclose the other's

parts.note: lessens means eases, as pain eases
MPH, miles per hour, is the unit of speed

explanation.surface: Cutting your speed reduces the strain of driving.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural noun: points of emphasis are the stresses laid on particular words or ideas.

clue.text: You need transport here, Doctor — Jack's caught a whale

parts.note: MO is medical officer, a doctor

indicators.note: the sailor has caught the whale, holding it within

parts.note: a jack or jack tar is a sailor, a TAR
an orc is an old name for the killer whale or grampus

explanation.surface: A doctor needs a vehicle because a sailor has landed a whale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'caught' puts ORC inside TAR, after MO; 'You need ... here' frames the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An automobile is a means of getting about by road.

clue.text: One feels at ease here, in and out

parts.note: to be in is to be at home
to be out is to be away from home

explanation.surface: A comfortable place you can come and go from.
explanation.walkthrough: In means at home; out means away from home; the two halves together give the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A place as comfortable and welcoming as one's own house.

clue.text: Burn slowly, beginning to smoke and turn to dust

indicators.note: beginning to smoke means only the opening letter of that word

parts.note: to moulder is to decay and crumble

explanation.surface: A fire first smokes and then reduces to ash.
explanation.definitionFit: To burn without flame, glowing and smoking.

clue.text: Eke out porridge

definitions.meaning: British slang for a prison sentence, time served

explanation.definitionFit: To make something go further is to extend it, and a stint in jail is a term served.

clue.text: Go straight for a mile after road excavation starts

indicators.note: after puts the words for and mile behind the opening letters
starts of road excavation means the opening letter of each of those two words

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A road crew's work begins a mile further on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starts' gives RE from road excavation; 'after' sets FOR and M behind.
explanation.definitionFit: To give up crime and live honestly is to mend one's ways.

clue.text: Signal to stop one out of the running

indicators.note: one out of means the letter for one is dropped

parts.note: the going is the state of the course in racing, or progress
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A warning to halt for one runner leaving the race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of' removes I from GOING. Police cars once sounded a gong to tell drivers to pull over.
explanation.definitionFit: A police car's bell or chime told a British motorist to pull over.

clue.text: Foreign exchanges are next to lower pound

indicators.note: to lower puts the pound sign at the bottom of this down entry
exchanges means the letters of are next swap places

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for pound, from libra

explanation.surface: Overseas currency trading pushes the pound down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exchanges' rearranges ARE NEXT into EXTERNA; 'to lower' puts L beneath.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to outside affairs, as in external relations with other nations.

clue.text: Ancient city in charge, not a part of modern one

indicators.note: in places the ancient city inside the trimmed charge
not a tells us to drop the letter A from the word for charge

parts.note: a charge levied by government is a tax
the letter A is what is taken away
Hebron is an ancient city of the West Bank, mentioned in the Bible

explanation.surface: A historic city was once in control but is not part of any modern one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not a' turns TAX into TX, and 'in' puts HEBRON inside it. The modern city of the definition is New York.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the five boroughs of New York, a modern city, unlike the ancient one in the wordplay.

clue.text: Staunch support for Flora

definitions.meaning: to staunch a flow of blood is to stop or check it
the stalk holding up a flower; Flora is the plant life of a region

explanation.definitionFit: To stem a flow is to stop it, and a plant's stalk holds up its flower.

clue.text: Three points about a good clue — it's cryptic or it smells

indicators.note: the compass points stand about, that is around, the rearranged letters

parts.note: ENE, east-north-east, is a compass point spelt with three point letters

indicators.note: a cryptic version of the words is a disguised one, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A remark about a crossword clue: it is either clever or it stinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cryptic' makes AUDECOLOG from A GOOD CLUE; 'about' sets E and NE around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Cologne is a scented toilet water worn for its pleasant fragrance.

clue.text: Clematis providing accommodation for several nests

definitions.meaning: a wild climbing plant with feathery seed heads
Edward Lear's limerick has an old fellow whose whiskers housed two owls, a hen, four larks and a wren

explanation.definitionFit: The wild clematis is named for its fluffy grey seed heads, and Lear's limerick has birds nesting in an elderly man's whiskers.

clue.text: Accumulated points — twenty-five hundred

parts.note: a score is twenty
D is the Roman numeral for five hundred

explanation.surface: A team has racked up a tally of twenty-five hundred.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twenty-five hundred' splits as twenty, then five hundred.
explanation.definitionFit: Past tense verb: a side that piled up runs or goals has notched them on the board.

clue.text: Light causes disappointment

definitions.meaning: to light is to alight or land, as a bird lights on a branch
a letdown, a fall in status or expectation

explanation.definitionFit: To descend and settle is to alight, and a letdown after high hopes is a fall from grace.

clue.text: Be nosy about leader returned in election

indicators.note: the prying word goes about, that is around, the turned leader

parts.note: to be nosy is to pry

indicators.note: returned means the word for leader is read backwards

parts.note: an amir (emir) is a Muslim ruler or commander

explanation.surface: Someone snoops on a leader who has been re-elected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns AMIR into RIMA, and 'about' puts PRY around it.
explanation.definitionFit: In the US a preliminary vote choosing a party's candidate is called this.

clue.text: The Left declared an end to the Canal

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
declared means said

explanation.surface: Left-wingers announced the closing of a waterway.
explanation.definitionFit: The Egyptian port lies at the northern, Mediterranean, end of the Suez Canal.

clue.text: Shock absorber for engineers demonstrating wear

indicators.note: the shocking word absorbs, taking in, the engineers

parts.note: to shock is to appal
RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

explanation.surface: A car part made for mechanics is on show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shock absorber' reads as a car part; 'absorber for' puts RE inside APPAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Noun: clothing in general is what one wears.

clue.text: Top and bottom of sail fixed in boat

indicators.note: fixed in puts the letter inside the boat

parts.note: a pinnace is a small ship's boat

indicators.note: bottom of sail means its last letter, at the foot of this down entry

explanation.surface: A sail's head and foot are rigged in a small boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bottom of' gives L; 'fixed in' puts it inside PINNACE.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest point or peak of something.

clue.text: Praise editing epilogue's shorter by a page

indicators.note: editing means the letters are reworked into a new order
shorter by means a letter is cut out of the word

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for page

explanation.surface: A tribute is made by trimming a page from a book's closing section.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shorter by' drops P from EPILOGUES, leaving EILOGUES; 'editing' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak highly of someone, especially in a funeral tribute.

clue.text: A game little creature

definitions.meaning: the bat-and-ball sport played in England

explanation.definitionFit: The English bat-and-ball sport shares its name with a small chirping insect.

clue.text: It goes round the arm

parts.note: the arm is a firearm, and the weapon's cylinder turns as it fires; not something worn on the limb

explanation.definitionFit: A pistol with a rotating chamber holding several rounds is a firearm whose part turns.

clue.text: Shortened version of bible may reveal God

indicators.note: shortened means the Bible's name is cut back to its opening part

parts.note: the Vulgate is the Latin version of the Bible
may means can, be able to

explanation.surface: An abridged Bible may show a deity.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman deity of fire and the forge.

clue.text: Head will, they say, settle down

indicators.note: they say signals that the words are judged as spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: a ness is a headland, and will contracts to 'll, so the phrase is spoken as ness'll

explanation.surface: A leader, people claim, will calm things down.
explanation.walkthrough: Head is a headland, NESS, as in Loch Ness's neighbour Orford Ness; NESS'LL is said like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To snuggle in and make oneself comfortable is to settle cosily.

clue.text: In the race, the places are put in order

definitions.text: In the race, the places are put in order

parts.words: In the race, the places are put in order
parts.note: the original cross-country horse race ran from one church tower to the next, so the landmarks were taken in turn

explanation.walkthrough: Not an anagram: THE PLACES lacks three of the letters needed. Such races first ran from church spire to church spire across country.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse race over fences, named from early races run towards a distant church spire.

clue.text: Some Icelandic spirit

indicators.note: some of the word means a run of its letters is taken from inside it

explanation.surface: A bit of Icelandic liquor.
explanation.definitionFit: Verve, dash and flair: a lively spirit.

clue.text: A kiss is what everything turns on

parts.note: X is the kiss written at the end of a letter

explanation.surface: Romance claims a kiss is the hinge of all things.
explanation.definitionFit: A pivot line about which a body rotates, as the earth spins on it.

clue.text: A visitor to America is agitated

definitions.meaning: anyone touring the USA is inside one of its fifty states

explanation.definitionFit: A tourist in the USA is within one of its states, and someone flustered is worked up.

clue.text: Resident upset people with it

indicators.note: upset means the letters of the word Resident are knocked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: A local is annoyed by the fashionable crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: Fashionable people are those who are 'with it', following the latest style.
